title: Enterprise Connectivity: refund authorization identity
content:
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity applies this refund authorization identity rule to assisted overpayment payout.

## Basis: selected authorization
For assisted overpayment payout, the assisted payout cycle handles the latest pending refund authorization on the selected holding by occurrence time; its latest timestamp must be unique, and its exact request identifier fixes the authorization throughout this cycle.

## Basis: selected remittance
For assisted overpayment payout, read source-event reference from that exact selected pending refund authorization to identify its original payment.

## Basis Q&A
**What governs assisted overpayment payout here?** Read source-event reference from that exact selected pending refund authorization to identify its original payment.
